explication: LLMRouter is a framework for training, evaluating, and serving cost- and quality-aware LLM routers. The principal workflow is: a user submits a query through the CLI or an OpenAI-compatible server; a router selects a model; the system calls that model and returns the response. Training flows from benchmark or generated data through loaders and embeddings into router implementations, while evaluation replays routing outcomes and measures quality/cost. Some router families and UI wiring are represented from README/tree evidence rather than sampled implementations.
